content.text: The love that Liverpool fans had for Diogo Jota was reflected in the popularity of the song they wrote in his honour.
Liverpool players and staff, past and present have been paying tribute to their player, team-mate and friend Diogo Jota throughout the day.
Liverpool head coach Arne Slot has also released a statement following the tragic passing of Diogo Jota and his brother Andre Silva.
Diogo Jota has achieved success with Liverpool, securing four trophies: a Premier League title, an FA Cup, a League Cup, and a UEFA Nations League title.
